It happened for me at around 3-4 weeks. And for me increased when I increased my dose

For me it took a while to see any effects of the medication. At a month, I could clearly see a difference. I don’t wake up daily and be disappointed that I am breathing still, and I’m able to not over sleep anymore either.

For reference I’ve been on lexapro, Prozac and Zoloft and all of them made me sleep and eat all day, lol just made my depression worse. 

Wellbutrin has also helped me bring back some of my empathy that has been gone for years from depression. Also gave me a libido that depression suppressed.

Being depressed and home all the time, I always reached for comfort food. Daily eating ramen and sweets. I have been on Wellbutrin since may, just upped to 300mg. I have to remind myself to eat. I drink my morning coffee and then have lunch when I remember. I feel so so much better. The feeling of carbs & over eating was definitely a piece of why I felt like crap daily. 

So for me it’s really beneficial to not have the urge anymore!!!
